name: Path of Exile 2
format: INI sections ACTION_KEYS and WASD_ACTION_KEYS; numeric key codes and optional modifier fields
limitations: The primary requested SPARSE6 family has 46 placements per preset. GROUPED R2 is retained as a separate alternative with 33 placements per preset and 13 capacity-deferred actions per preset.
Installing both family alternatives into one active game map would conflict. No change to the active movement mode, skill loadout, mouse controls or Azeron profiles is authorized.
Current game field names must confirm new actions such as Market. The 2024 firsthand config dump does not establish every 2026 option.
GROUPED R2 can displace capacity-deferred actions (for example inventory). Those actions cannot silently be cleared.
